ella: quick note from a host profiling run on small requests (~60 tokens): extra ~20ms host-side before runtime. looks like tokenize + http2 framing + kvcache stalls.
sam: paste the hotspot summary?
ella: top hotspots:
```: preparse::tokenize 14.2ms; http2::framer/read 3.6ms; kvcache::lookup 2.7ms (missy); writev syscalls many smallwrites ~1.9ms total```
andrew: recent changes: kv sharding increased to 16 shards (PR 1533) and net coalesce flag landed (PR 1540). could be an interaction.
sam: that would explain hit-rate drop for short prefixes. can you enable KVCACHE_DEBUG and WRITEV_COALESCE=0/1?
ella: toggled: coalesce=1 reduces p95 by ~5ms; shard_count=8 reduces another ~6ms. combined gets us near baseline.
perf-bot: [alert] canary 2024-10-20T14:05:00Z -> host preparse p95 +18ms for small-req cohort.
andrew: action: sam to bisect 1520..1545, i'll open a short rollback for shard_count and batch_hint if bisect confirms. also add host preparse p95 test for short requests.
sam: starting bisect now, will report back in morning.
ella: pushing perf traces to /tmp/host-flames/3487654322.tar.gz. linking in infra board.
